rules.text: You must ship the item back within 7 days of starting the return.
rules.quote: You need to start the return within 7 days of delivery, and ship the item back within 7 days of starting the return.

rules.text: Bundle purchases are currently excluded from Worry-Free Returns.
You start a return claim through the order page or via the Worry-Free Returns purchase confirmation email.
rules.quote: To start a return claim through Seel, go to the order page > select _Problems/Order Inquiry_ \> select _Item does not fit_ or _Changed my mind about the item_. You will be redirected to the Seel Resolution Center to initiate a return claim.

rules.text: The Worry-Free Returns fee is a small percentage of your order total and is optional at checkout.
rules.quote: The fee is a small percentage of your order total. The exact cost will show at checkout before you confirm your order.

rules.text: Return shipping is prepaid by Seel; you do not pay for return shipping.
rules.quote: Nope! Seel will send you a prepaid shipping label for returning the item.

rules.text: Refunds are issued via direct bank transfer (ACH), Venmo, or PayPal after the return is processed.
rules.quote: Refunds are sent via direct bank transfer (ACH), Venmo, or PayPal.

rules.text: Worry-Free Returns handles returns and refunds directly; sellers do not need to take action or receive returned items.
rules.quote: When a buyer files a Worry-Free Returns claim, no action is needed by the seller.

rules.text: You can cancel your Worry-Free Returns purchase within 24 hours of purchase via the confirmation email link or by contacting Seel.
rules.quote: You can cancel within 24 hours of purchase using the link in your confirmation email from Seel, or by contacting Seel directly on resolve.seel.com/poshmark.
